No long tail, shag, high white socks, black saddle, giant eyes or puppy head. Buddy has a full moderately elongated continuous charcoal close-coated torso, deep chest, visible neck and genuine leg clearance on substantial legs. Modest projecting muzzle, cream moustache/beard, light curved brows, tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet, softly pendant ears. Actual selected original photographs govern only visible anatomy; generated model supplies provisional pen/wash style, never anatomy authority. Uncalibrated photos establish no fixed proportions/relative scale, weight, ancestry, motion timing, psychology or exact palette. N35 excludes anatomy; B08 styling only and not used; B25 unavailable; B30 supplemental resting evidence only and not used. Multiple encodings of one exposure count once. B04/B24 one exposure, only B04 here. Do not copy photo backgrounds. No costume/collar/extra objects unless specified by actual scene. Draw clear contour/support construction and complete room staging for inspection.
